name: BEAUTIFUL: Scene Red
source:
Even in his dreams Jas can't escape the truth of who he is, a normal kid.

In the near-future, Jas Reroegha struggles with feeling any sort of excitement in his everyday life, but once he finds a glimpse of meaning in his life by learning what MiST is, he gets thrown into great turmoil and trouble disrupting his sound of mind.

[From [url=https://jambyu.itch.io/beautiful-scene-red]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
即使在梦中，贾斯也无法逃避自己的真实身份：一个普通的孩子。

在不久的将来，贾斯·雷罗加 (Jas Reroegha) 很难在日常生活中感受到任何兴奋，但一旦他通过了解什么是MiST找到了生活的意义，他就会陷入巨大的混乱和麻烦，扰乱他的心智。

[来自[url=https://jambyu.itch.io/beautiful-scene-red]itch.io[/url]]
